title: CFTC proposes some limits (but not many) on in-game prediction markets

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: CFTC proposes some limits (but not many) on in-game prediction markets
sources.description: As prediction markets run by the likes of Polymarket and Kalshi operate more and more like sportsbooks (to the chagrin of the sportsbooks that don't operate prediction markets), regulation is needed.
